name: paytm
description: PayTm clone: React + Express + MongoDB wallet with transactional transfers

scripts.install-dependencies: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
